branding_approval.name: branding_approval
branding_approval.value: ("branding_versions"."status"='Approved') = ("branding_versions"."approved_by" is not null and "branding_versions"."approved_at" is not null and "branding_versions"."customer_approver" is not null and "branding_versions"."approval_reference" is not null)

cutting_batch_valid.name: cutting_batch_valid
cutting_batch_valid.value: "cutting_batches"."quantity">0 and "cutting_batches"."planned">0 and "cutting_batches"."status" in ('Planned','Completed','Cancelled') and ("cutting_batches"."status"='Completed')=("cutting_batches"."result" is not null and "cutting_batches"."completed_by" is not null)

delivery_status.name: delivery_status
delivery_status.value: "delivery_orders"."status" in ('Picking','Packed','Dispatched','In Transit','Delivered','Exception','Cancelled') and (("delivery_orders"."status" in ('Picking','Packed','Cancelled'))=("delivery_orders"."shipment_id" is null and "delivery_orders"."dispatched_at" is null))

fabric_roll_quantities.name: fabric_roll_quantities
fabric_roll_quantities.value: "fabric_rolls"."width_cm">0 and "fabric_rolls"."received_length">0 and "fabric_rolls"."physical_length">="fabric_rolls"."received_length" and "fabric_rolls"."remaining_length">=0 and "fabric_rolls"."remaining_length"<="fabric_rolls"."physical_length" and "fabric_rolls"."reserved_length">=0 and "fabric_rolls"."held_length">=0 and "fabric_rolls"."reserved_length"+"fabric_rolls"."held_length"<="fabric_rolls"."remaining_length"

labor_quantities.name: labor_quantities
labor_quantities.value: "labor_entries"."sequence">=0 and "labor_entries"."completed">=0 and "labor_entries"."rejected">=0 and ("labor_entries"."ended_at" is null or "labor_entries"."ended_at">="labor_entries"."started_at")

pricing_rule_valid.name: pricing_rule_valid
pricing_rule_valid.value: "pricing_rules"."kind" in ('Contract','Customer','Volume','Standard') and "pricing_rules"."currency" in ('UZS','USD') and "pricing_rules"."minimum">0 and "pricing_rules"."start_date"<="pricing_rules"."end_date" and "pricing_rules"."status" in ('Draft','Approved','Rejected') and ("pricing_rules"."status"='Approved')=("pricing_rules"."approved_by" is not null) and (("pricing_rules"."kind" in ('Contract','Customer'))=("pricing_rules"."customer_id" is not null))

quotation_status.name: quotation_status
quotation_status.value: "quotations"."status" in ('Draft','Approved','Rejected','Converted') and "quotations"."total">=0 and ("quotations"."status" in ('Approved','Converted'))=("quotations"."approved_by" is not null)

valid_sales_line.name: valid_sales_line
valid_sales_line.value: "sales_order_items"."quantity">0 and "sales_order_items"."price">=0 and "sales_order_items"."discount">=0 and "sales_order_items"."discount"<=100 and "sales_order_items"."reserved">=0 and "sales_order_items"."shipped">=0 and "sales_order_items"."reserved"+"sales_order_items"."shipped"<="sales_order_items"."quantity"

spec_approval_metadata.name: spec_approval_metadata
spec_approval_metadata.value: ("product_specifications"."status"='Approved') = ("product_specifications"."approved_by" is not null and "product_specifications"."approved_at" is not null)
